(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A battery assembly comprising: an enclosure; a first battery cell positioned within the enclosure; and a first sensor positioned within the enclosure for detecting at least one force influencing the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor includes force sensing material configured to vary its conductance based on the at least one force influencing the first battery cell.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell, and the first sensor is configured to detect at least one force influencing the second battery cell.

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising: a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell; a third battery cell stacked on top of the second battery cell; and a second sensor positioned between the third battery cell and the second battery cell for detecting at least one force influencing the third battery cell, wherein at least one of the first sensor and the second sensor comprises force sensing circuitry configured to produce a force output signal based on the detected at least one force.

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises a contact sensor made of a quantum tunneling composite.

(Currently Amended) Claim 26: The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises a pressure sensitive ink that varies in response to at least one force influencing the first battery cell.
